Italian restaurant located next to the Blue House in Samcheong-dong.

Reservation required. It is operated as a no-kids zone, so you can enjoy a meal in a pleasant atmosphere with your family, gatherings, lovers, or VIPs.

There is no public transportation nearby, so a private car or taxi is recommended.

It may be difficult to visit if you are visiting for the first time as it is located at the far end of the alley.

The restaurant is located on a hill, so you can feel a refreshing sense of openness through the open view and unadorned garden. When making a reservation, it is recommended to make a reservation near the window.

The spacing between the seats is wide, so the risk of disturbing or being disturbed by the people next to you is low.

The restaurant does not serve alcohol. Only non-alcoholic drinks are available.

Each dish has a unique personality and is rich in flavor. You can experience the original taste of food ingredients.

They sell a cost-effective menu, and although the taste is not dramatic, it does not disappoint.

When serving a meal, the menu is introduced and the method of eating is explained in a friendly and detailed manner.

It was my first visit and I am very satisfied. The best dishes were the gazpacho and lamb ribs and the starters were also very good.

Starter Accra seemed to have exactly the image that Galopant was pursuing. Although it was a very casual food choice, the warm scent and soft texture of the tilefish were conveyed, and the flavor of the rich cheese gave it weight. I could feel the lightness of Gallopin, which was not burdensome in its seriousness, but did not stand out too much. I think it's a well-made amuse bouche.

I think gazpacho was the best menu item in my opinion. The unique gazpacho made with green grapes and spinach oil had a great balance of flavors, and the combination of heavy feta cheese and light frisché was amazing. How delicious the green beans and pickled olives were. The quail eggs, which I was worried about, were not fishy at all and went well together. Even though it is a dish with very little added to the ingredients, it was made so well that the flavor of the gazpacho did not take precedence alone, so I could really taste the taste of seasonal food and it was like eating summer itself.

As soon as I tried it, I knew why everyone raved about the lamb ribs. I didn't feel the unique smell at all, and the more I chewed, the more I felt the deep meaty flavor of lamb ribs in my mouth. Even considering just the lamb ribs, it was a dish that eliminated the flaws and added only the good points through fresh ingredients and cooking that was faithful to the basics. However, the bigger highlight of this dish was the mashed potato garnish using corn. The horseradish-based sauce maximizes the flavor of the lamb ribs, and the mashed potatoes, which add a subtle sweetness by adding corn, cut down on the previously bloated taste, creating the best balance. The common chestnut puree or port wine sauce with a little pear added are safe, but how boring are they? The food was truly excellent, sticking to the basics and showing off as much personality as possible within a safe zone.

Considering the price, I think it is a really well-constructed portfolio for the price. Of course, there were foods that differed in taste, but I don't think it's necessary to write about them. The fact that none of the 11 menu items had any flaws in the basics is worthy of applause. I can't give it 5 stars for the cozy bathroom, passionate chef, servers, and night view.

This is Baskin Robbins located on a traditional Korean house street. If it's not too cold, you can eat it on a table in the yard. Upon entering the store, two cauldrons greet customers. I am deducting one star because the interior of the store is so small that it can be quite hectic when there are a lot of customers.

reviews.author: Jeon Hyeon-gyu
reviews.text: I went to Chims Burger, a famous handmade burger restaurant in Anguk, Anguk Station Branch😍 It's a 3-minute walk from Exit 2 of Anguk Station and across from the Constitutional Court, so it's easy to find with a hip exterior. Although it is small, the interior is fully equipped with a graffiti wall and hangers and has a cozy atmosphere, and the system where you receive a number ticket after ordering at the kiosk is convenient! I ordered Blue Chims (double) and Mad Chick Chims. The brioche bun was moist, the gorgonzola was salty and juicy, the beef patty melted in my mouth, and the chicken burger with fried chicken thighs, bacon, cheese, and chili sauce was an explosion of flavor🤤 The eggplant fries were crispy and moist, the ranch sauce was perfect, and the Cajun fries were perfect! Highly recommended for a Gatseongbi Anguk date with a discounted lunch set👍

🇰🇷 Le Labo Bukchon Hanok Branch

Le Labo Bukchon Hanok Branch, located in Bukchon Hanok Village, is a unique perfume space that harmoniously blends in with traditional Hanok architecture, unlike typical shopping mall stores.

As you enter the alley, the wooden doors and low roof give you the feeling of entering a quiet traditional Korean house. When you open the door and enter, you will see a sunny space with preserved wooden beams and bars, decorated with Le Labo's signature minimalist style and warm lighting. The subtle scent slowly spreads and relaxes your mind.

The space is small, but every corner is charming, and it combines the simple atmosphere of a hanok with Le Labo's unique modern minimalism. When trying perfume, the staff will kindly explain the story and characteristics of each perfume, so you can have a comfortable and enjoyable time.

This is a place where you can not only admire the traditional architecture of Bukchon, but also enjoy a special and comfortable scent experience. Highly recommended to those who love scents and beautiful spaces!

I was curious about Bukchon Osulloc Tea House every time I passed through Samcheong-dong, and I finally visited it during the holidays. As expected, as it is a popular place, it was fully booked so I had to be careful to get a seat. It is a renovated three-story house, with tea and gift items available for viewing and purchasing on the first floor, and cafe seating starting from the second floor. The view of Bukchon and the Hanok stone walls outside the window are really pretty, and the terrace area has a nice atmosphere, making it especially suitable for spring and fall.
The menu I ordered was ‘Bukchon’s Saekdong’, a dessert exclusive to Bukchon Osulloc Tea House, Gotchawal, and green oolong tea. It was fun to experience as they explained the tea and told us the time with an hourglass. The Saekdong rice cake set is served warm, and you can eat it with cheese, millet, slices, and gamtae roll rice cakes dipped in various sauces. The gamtae roll rice cake was especially impressive and went well with tea. Although it was pricey, it was a tea house that was satisfactory from the view, tea, and dessert.

A teahouse operated by Osulloc, a Jeju-based premium tea brand. It is located on the second floor of a modernly reinterpreted Hanok building next to Bukchon Hanok Village, and the third floor is operated as a bar space selling cocktails.

On the first floor, you can purchase car-related supplies, and the movement line is designed to allow you to pass by naturally. It has a nice location, is like a gallery, and has a Korean aesthetic, so there were an overwhelming number of foreign customers.

We ordered one matcha soft serve ice cream per person. As it was made by mixing matcha powder, the dark color and soft texture were impressive, and the sweetness of the milk mixed with the subtle bitterness of the matcha.

It was a cold day so I didn't sit on the terrace, but the Bukchon Hanok Village peeking out through the floor-to-ceiling windows caught my eye. It was a nice enough scene for two Korean men and a Japanese man to share.

reviews.author: Ali Sharif
reviews.text:
I visited Dadam Tea House in Bukchon Hanok Village, and it was a truly beautiful and peaceful experience. The interior of the traditional hanok had a very Korean feel and was very calming.

I ordered wild white tea, and the atmosphere was elegant. Warm water was poured at the table, and the whole process felt meticulous and formal. The tea has a subtle and mellow flavor.

We also tried milk tea and traditional Korean desserts, which went beautifully with the tea and were served beautifully.

Highly recommended for those who want to experience quiet, authentic Korean tea while visiting Bukchon.

reviews.author: Ken Redline
reviews.text: This is a great place to try high-quality Chinese tea. The milk tea was really delicious, and I was very satisfied with the variety of teas needed for the tea ceremony (the tea was brewed directly in front of the guests). My family had a great time stopping by here while staying in a hanok.

reviews.author: Laura Ruiz
reviews.text: I had two glasses of lemonade and it was really nice because it was fresh and not at all sweet! The atmosphere was comfortable and the service was great!

reviews.author: Dreamer JO
reviews.text: Inlaid celadon, Buncheong porcelain, and Joseon white porcelain are on display. You can also enjoy a variety of refreshments (hangwa, Korean snacks) and fragrant tea. The tea was refilled. They also play calming background music. It's a great place for a peaceful rest.

reviews.author: - Song
reviews.text:
It's a space where you can quietly heal in very busy Seoul.
The person who explained it was friendly, the tea was delicious, and the refreshments were neat, so I think it will be memorable :)

reviews.author: minju lee
reviews.text: I visited by chance, and they were friendly and the atmosphere was elegant and very nice.

reviews.author: Мария Стратинская
reviews.text: This is a shopping experience on a different level. Here you are not buying perfume, you are buying an experience!! You have created such an amazing space, I don't think anyone can match this level. I was really impressed!!! Thank you so much for allowing me to have this experience ❤️

reviews.author: Semmi
reviews.text: It's the perfect place to take a break in the middle of a bustling city! The tea ceremony experience was also really good. The tea was really refreshing and the traditional snacks served were also really delicious! I would definitely recommend it if you are in the area. We also sell curated mini vases!

reviews.author: Seunghyun Lee
reviews.text: I discovered this brand while looking for cosmetics with good ingredients, but I didn't know they had an offline flagship store! I happened to have an appointment near Anguk Station, so I stopped by during the time, and it gave me a reason to go to Anguk often. There was a photo booth, and it had a very Instagrammable feel. I really liked that the staff didn't put any pressure on me, and they came and answered kindly when I asked questions!! It is highly recommended as a date course~~

reviews.author: Glow_scent 03
reviews.text:
While walking around Samcheong-dong, I happened to see an alley and saw a luxurious building, so I went in!
I thought it was like a museum, but it turned out to be a beauty shop :) There were a lot of different cosmetics, but they were well organized, so I was able to look around comfortably. There were old books in the basement, and the materials used in the products were also on display! The faucet on the first floor was really cool haha. There was a tester placed so that I could use the product, and it made me feel better about the product :D haha ​​Products with traditional patterns would be good as gifts, and there were many cute traditional accessories, so it was fun to look around the showroom!! If you come with foreign friends, I think you'll like it because you can show them the beauty of Korea :D

reviews.author: Eunha Hwang
reviews.text: When I went to Samcheong-dong, there was a building I had never seen before, so I went in! It was a little inside, so I wondered if I could go in, but when I got closer, the building was so pretty that I plucked up the courage to go in!! From the exterior to the inside of the building, everything has a Korean feel, so I saw a lot of people taking pictures, from people wearing hanbok to foreigners! It looked so pretty!! There are a lot of different products, and more than anything, it looks very luxurious when combined with mother-of-pearl cabinetry, so I asked the staff about it and they said that the black tea line was on display! The product package explained that it was a luxurious and anti-aging line, so I immediately bought the black tea gift set because I thought my mom would like it!! My mom was so satisfied that I recommend it as a skin care gift set that is great to give to adults!

reviews.author: Jihyun Kim
reviews.text: I often bought Pyunkangyul products because they were not irritating, but when I bought them online, I found myself hesitating because I wanted to test out new products and then buy them! It was so nice to have a showroom so I could test it out before buying!! I really like Pyunkangyul’s unique Korean atmosphere! One more reason to go on an outing to Bukchon^~^ I think my foreign friends would like it, but I don't have any foreign friends, so I'm going to take a friend who looks like a foreigner. I think I bought too much more than I thought, but the staff explained it well, and my skin was really good, so I just bought it. My wallet got lighter, but I don't regret it. I'll visit again when I run out of what I bought! Guut

reviews.author: Danbi Kim
reviews.text:
I was very interested in the Pyunkangyul brand because I liked the Pyunkangyul toner and cleansing balm black tea line, but they opened a flagship store recently?!
I was surprised that it was prettier than I expected.
The view out the window is so pretty, and the store itself is worth taking a photo to prove it. There were so many spaces that I was busy taking pictures as soon as I entered.
Looking at the people, there were a lot of foreigners coming. The store itself was Korean-style, so foreigners liked it.
There were a lot of people wearing hanbok, so it looked prettier!
I was so disappointed that I couldn't test it because there was only an online store, but it was great that there were testers here!
The atmosphere is comfortable and it's not like they're trying to sell something, so it's nice to relax.
It was close to Anguk Station and there were many good restaurants, so it was a good choice to include it as a destination course!

reviews.author: Crystal
reviews.text:
Bukchon Makgeolli is so delicious.
It's thicker and sweeter than regular makgeolli, so it's good to drink with it like dessert wine.
The pretty label is a bonus 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Jeong Geun-hye
reviews.text:
I received Bukchon Makgeolli via delivery. Oh my goodness... They packaged it so carefully and safely, and the package is so luxurious. I don’t think any other wine packaging looks like this. I thought that if I had the chance to give something as a gift someday, I would do it with this.
The taste of makgeolli has a luxurious consistency (but not too thick and just right) and a sweet taste that is great to drink coolly in the summer. It goes well with pancakes or meat rather than fruit snacks. I drank it with chive salad and boiled pork😚
I recommend Bukchon Makgeolli for home parties or as gifts 🍶
